Event Info

Håfa Adai!

NEW YEAR. NEW CHALLENGES. BIGGER BATTLES!

Kick off 2027 with one of Guam's premier Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu competitions — the 2027 GUAM COPA DE MARIANAS GI & NO-GI TOURNAMENT!

Get ready for an exciting day of fierce competition, incredible talent, and unforgettable moments on the mats! Whether you're a seasoned competitor or stepping into the competition scene for the first time, this is your chance to test your skills, represent your academy, and compete for a spot on the podium!

Don't miss your chance to be part of the action! Start the year strong, challenge yourself, and show everyone what you've been training for.

The mats are calling. Are you ready to rise to the challenge?

We'll see you on the mats!

SEE EVENT DETAILS BELOW

This is a Gi and No-Gi event, with separate event registration pages for each tournament.

  • If you are competing in GI only, please register on this event page.
  • If you are competing in NO-Gi only, please register on the NO-Gi event page: https://asjjf.org/main/eventInfo?id=2259
  • If you plan to compete in BOTH GI AND NO-Gi, you must register separately on each respective event page.
  • Please ensure you carefully review the information below for this event

MARIANAS SPORTS JIU-JITSU FEDERATION CONTACT INFORMATION: moguam@marianasopen.com

Stay up to date with the latest tournament announcements/notices by visiting our website at: www.marianasopen.com or follow our Instagram page: @themarianasopen !

VENUE: University Calvo Fieldhouse Mangilao, Guam

Registration Information (note that times indicated are Chamoru Standard Time, ChST)

Registration deadline:

Thursday, January 21, 2027 ends at 11:59 PM (Important note: Registration may close earlier than the deadline if the maximum number of participants is reached.)

ATHLETE AND COACH correction deadline:

Saturday, January 23, 2027  ends at 11:59 PM

Note: Athletes and Coaches have a 2 day window from the registration deadline to the correction deadline to review the Fighter's List and make necessary changes.

  • If you have no opponent in your division; please access your account and make changes division. If you are experiencing issues making changes, contact us for a change of division or you will automatically receive a medal (alone brackets/no opponent).
  • The Fighter's List is official and it will be used to generate the brackets. Please be sure to check your details in the Fighter's List before the correction deadline. Further, awards will only be given to those who are listed in the brackets so please check.

If the athlete, Coach or parent is experiencing difficulties making changes on the system, you may send your requested changes via email to moguam@marianasopen.com with the following information included:

  • Fighter’s name
  • Tournament Name and whether it's for Gi or No-Gi
  • Necessary Corrections
  • Make sure the subject on the email is “[Name] Corrections"

 

REGISTRATION CHECK DAY:

Sunday, January 24, 2027 from 12:00 AM - 11:59 PM

Registration Check Day is designated for athletes and coaches/professors who submitted correction requests during the official Athlete Correction Timeframe (January 21-23, 2027).

All athletes and coaches are required to review the “Fighters List” to verify that their requested changes have been accurately made.

New correction requests will not be accepted. 

 

Organizer’s correction day: 

Monday, January 25, 2027 ends at 11:59 PM

Only corrections due to registration errors made by the federation will be accepted.
New correction requests will not be accepted.

Cancellation & Refund request day and Refund Policy:
Sunday, January 24, 2027 ends at 11:59pm 
Only applicable to athletes with no opponents (alone in the bracket).

The registration fee is non-refundable and non-transferable. Exemption: Athletes who are alone in their bracket are eligible to receive a full refund of the registration fee if they contact moguam@marianasopen.com and request to withdraw their name from the competition prior to the end of the appointed event Refund Deadline.

【 Cancellation & Refund policy 】

 Refund eligibility applies only if, at the time of the「Cancellation & Refund request acceptance day (within the 24 hour period), the athlete has no opponent (single entry).

～ Important ～
 ・ Even if there is no opponent before the「Cancellation & Refund request acceptance day (within the 24 hour period)」, an opponent may appear up until the day before the designated day. Therefore, refund requests cannot be made before the designated date. Whether a refund is possible is determined only based on the situation on the designated date.

 ・ If no request is submitted by the specified day, the athlete will automatically become a solo champion and will not be eligible for a refund.

 ・ Intentional and malicious last minute changes to a “division without an opponent” will not be accepted as eligible for a refund.

 ・ Please register only after confirming that you can definitely participate on the tournament day.
 ※ Personal schedule changes are not covered by the established cancellation policy.

 ・ Registration in the weight division is mandatory to participate in the event. If the athlete also wishes to compete in the absolute division, an additional fee will be charged for the absolute registration. If, on the「Cancellation & Refund request acceptance day (within the 24 hour period)」, the athlete is registered in both divisions (weight and open weight) and only one of them has no opponent, cancellation may be requested only for the division without a match. In this case, the refund will be limited solely to the additional fee paid for the absolute division (that is, the difference), regardless of which division has no opponent. The base registration fee (weight division) is non refundable.
 ※ For example, if there is a match in the weight division but not in the absolute division, the athlete will receive a refund corresponding to the additional absolute division fee. Likewise, if there is a match in the absolute division but not in the weight division, the refund will also be limited to the additional fee difference only.

 ・ Entry fees cannot be transferred or carried over to another event.

【 KIDS Division – Category Criteria 】

 Transfers between male and female categories in the KIDS division are not permitted.
 *Male athletes must compete exclusively in male categories, and female athletes exclusively in female categories, with no exceptions, regardless of weight, age, or number of participants.

Important Responsibility Notice

It is the responsibility of the athlete, parent, and coach to actively review the Fighter’s List and communicate any requested changes to the MSJJF if you're unable to make the change yourself on the system.

  • We will no longer proactively review the Fighter’s List on your behalf.
  • Changes will only be made based on direct requests received.
  • MSJJF will not independently move athletes to different divisions.
  • Athletes/Parents and Coaches must coordinate with each other before contacting MSJJF to avoid confusion.
  • It is not the organizer’s responsibility to find an opponent for you.

Please be proactive to ensure you or your student has a match.

Schedule & Bracket Release Dates

  • Schedule release date: Thursday/Friday, January 28/29, 2027
  • Brackets release date: Thursday/Friday, January 28/29, 2027

IMPORTANT:  WE WILL BE WEIGHING - IN ALL ATHLETES IN KILOGRAMS.  PLEASE ENSURE YOU WEIGH YOURSELF/YOUR CHILD IN KILOS AND REGISTER THEM IN THEIR APPROPRIATE WEIGHT CATEGORY.

WEIGH-IN WILL OCCUR AT THE TIME OF THE EVENT.  IF YOU MISS WEIGHT YOU WILL BE AUTOMATICALLY DISQUALIFIED FOR THE EVENT AND YOUR POSITION WILL BE FORFEITED.​

Ranking Points System

This championship will be held as a 3-STAR certified event, with the following points awarded.

Fighters Ranking points (3 Star):

  • Gold - 45 points
  • Silver - 21 points
  • Bronze - 9 points
  • Alone Brackets - 0 points

Extra Points:
3 points per victory by submission
1 point per match victory

 Teams Ranking points (3 Star):

  • Gold - 45 points
  • Silver - 21 points
  • Bronze -  9 points
  • Alone Brackets - 0 points
  • One Brackets,  all same teams, 0 points

【 Uniform policy 】

 All uniforms must comply with ASJJF standards.
 ※ Non-compliant uniforms are not allowed.
 ※ It’s strongly recommended to bring two uniforms due to their condition and the possibility of them becoming dirty or damaged.

 Please check the following link before the event:
 ▶︎ Uniform Regulations (UNIFORM CHECK)
 ※ The above instructions are only available in English.

Conduct at the winnner´s podium:

  • We ask your understanding and cooperation in following these standard in the upcoming tournament: All competitors must be in proper uniform (full Gi for Gi competitions or rash guard and shorts for NO-GI competitions).
  • Banners are not permitted at the podium
  • Athletes who place in 1st, 2nd and 3rd in their division will receive a medal at the event. All the medals should be picked up at the event's podium.

Venue Guidelines:

  • If you are experiencing any flu like symptoms or have a high temperature, please remain at home and contact your health provider. This is extremely important for everyone involved.
  • If you are currently sick or have been exposed to someone that has tested positive for COVID- 19, please stay at home and contact your health provider.

Rules and Requirements for joining the event: 

  • Any athlete who has proven to be a black belt in judo,has fought MMA professionally, has an amateur MMA record or has proven experience in wrestling, Olympic wrestling or greco-Roman wrestling, can not participate in any league as a white belt. Proven experience in the U.S. consists of having competed at the collegiate level or highter and in other countries,having competed in nationwide events.
  • Kids Orange belt, Kids Yellow Belt, Kids Green belt, Kids Grey Belt, cannot participate in Juvenille or Adult as a white belt.
  • Matches may start 30 minutes in advance. Athletes should be in the warm up area at least 40 minutes prior to the time assigned for his or her division on the schedule.
  • It is mandatory to have an official government photo ID at all times.
  • The official weight measurements of this event is in KILOGRAMS.
  • All athletes must be affiliated with a black belt. Your head black belt can be in a different location/country, what’s important is you and the team that you are representing is properly recognized by the head instructor.
  • We reserve the right to check your affiliation. Failure to provide any means to contact your head instructor will not be accepted into the event.
  • All athletes must bring a valid ID on the event day. We reserve the right to randomly check IDs for verification purposes.
  • Any false information provided during registration such as, but not limited to, DOB, may lead to immediate disqualification. Such actions are subject to suspension or even banishment from future Marianas Open events.
  • If you are alone in your bracket you can access you account and make changes division, until day before registration check day and request a change on your registration. 
  • Marianas Sport Jiu-Jitsu Federation (MSJJF) does not guarantee that the division you want to be moved to will have another competitor at the day of the event.  The MSJJF reserves the right to close registration when we reach full capacity, or on the day of the appointed event registration deadline, whichever comes first.
  • It is the responsibility of the athlete to be knowledgeable of the rules and guidelines pertaining to the sport (as outlined in the Marianas Open Rules Book).
  • We strongly suggest that athlete registration is finalized before making any travel arrangements.
  • Before each fight, athletes will be asked to show their valid form of photo identification(ID) to the officials. Make sure you have it on hand.

BY ENTERING AND REGISTERING FOR THIS TOURNAMENT YOU AGREE TO THE FOLLOWING:

WAIVER OF PARTICIPATION
I HEREBY ASSUME FULL RESPONSIBILITY AND LIABILITY FOR ALL DAMAGES, INJURIES, AND LOSSES THAT I MAY SUSTAIN OR INCUR WHILE PARTICIPATING IN OR WATCHING THE 2027 GUAM COPA DE MARIANAS GI/NO-GI TOURNAMENT.

I realize that serious injury is commonplace in martial arts tournaments such as the one I am hereby entering and that death is a possibility. I also realize that if I am injured, I might be disfigured, disabled and/or rendered unable to work again. By entering into this competition I agree to and fully accept and assume liability for any and all injuries that I may incur. I expressly waive any and all claims that I or anyone acting on my behalf or through me might have against Fury Promotions, the Marianas Open, Copa de Marianas, event promoters, operators, sponsors, officials, participants, non-participants, or volunteers for any injury regardless of its nature, effect or affect on me as a result of my participation and/or presence at the tournament.

I authorize, and agree to hold harmless, any medical personnel that may be present at the event to take any action necessary, should I become injured.

I understand that tickets will be sold to spectators to watch the tournament; that news media and others might cover the tournament and that it may also be recorded or otherwise shown to audiences around the world. I hereby expressly and irrevocably forever consent to have my likeness shown, publicized, commented and/or reported on; and I do not expect to, and in fact waive any compensation I might otherwise be entitled to as a result thereof.

I represent that I am in good health; that I am not presently, nor will I participate while under the influence of any drug or medication; that no one affiliated with this tournament has encouraged me to enter or made any representations regarding my fitness or ability to participate; that I have read and understood every provision of this release; and that I am legally competent to and freely enter into this waiver, release and assumption of risk agreement.

Organizer: FURY PROMOTIONS, LLC/MARIANAS OPEN/MARIANAS PRO (hereinafter 'Organizer') expressly reserves the right, in its sole and absolute discretion, with or without cause, to change, modify or otherwise edit information contained upon the registration form, including but not limited to: the competitor's academy name and affiliation and/or the competitor's name and/or nickname.

Changes to a competitor's registration (including but not limited to: academy affiliation) will be permitted up to 11:59 PM ON JANUARY 23, 2027 (ATHLETE CORRECTION DEADLINE). There will be no changes permitted after that time.

The head coach of an academy's competition team shall be granted the right to change a competitor's registration information.
